verses.pali: “Yaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should give up desire and greed for what is impermanent.

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ, tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Form is impermanent; you should give up desire and greed for it.

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ aniccaṁ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo.
verses.english: Consciousness is impermanent; you should give up desire and greed for it.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, aniccaṁ; tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
verses.english: You should give up desire and greed for what is impermanent.”
